about_the_game:
[About the Demo Version]

In the holoReversi demo, you can experience the following content:

  • Offline Play

  1. Score Battle – A unique Reversi mode where players compete for the highest score.

  2. Count Battle – A custom Reversi mode where players compete based on the number of pieces at the end.

  3. Classic Battle – Standard Reversi rules.

Note: In the demo, only the "Totem" skill is available.
